title: Co-CoT: A Prompt-Based Framework for Collaborative Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper proposes a framework for collaborative reasoning and does not conduct any benchmarks related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this topic is outside its scope. The focus is on a general framework for collaborative reasoning, with a primary use case centered on ensuring fairness for minority dialects.
references: Alfred. V. Aho and Jeffrey D. Ullman. 1972. The Theory of Parsing, Translation and Compiling, volume 1. Prentice-Hall, Englewood Cliffs, NJ.
